note: Curated filter list for the product selector. Deliberately NOT derived from whatever tags appear in the data: an auto-populated selector grew to 26 checkboxes and buried the ones administrators actually use. Adding a tag to the taxonomy no longer adds a checkbox; it must be listed here.

groups.label: Products
groups.hint: Derived from the vendor's structured product list. Complete and deterministic.

options.label: Microsoft
options.overview_note: Kept as a checkbox but excluded from the overview board. It matches every record in the month, so as a tile it restates the month summary immediately above it and does so in whatever colour the single worst advisory dictates.

groups.label: Workloads
groups.hint: Roles taken from the component named in the advisory title, plus any the assessor adds from the advisory text. The vendor publishes the affected OS SKUs, not the role, so the title is where the component is stated.

excluded.azure: Azure vulnerabilities appear in the monthly cycle but are remediated by Microsoft directly, so there is no customer patching decision to support. Decision 2026-09-11.
